# Ungu
Ungu are a powerful, broad-shouldered species. They move slowly outside combat mode. Toggle [color=yellow]Combat Mode[/color] to pick up speed, but watch your corners. Hitting a wall at high speed can hurt and briefly stun you.
Use [color=yellow]Dash[/color] to charge up to four tiles in the direction you're facing. The charge can damage targets and breakable obstacles in your path. Dash requires gravity and has a 25-second cooldown.
